hypothesis: Causal prior-calendar-day directional efficiency and recent completed-hour efficiency can identify when to skip new entries. This may instead remove winners, reduce sample size, and fail on reversals. Preserve the existing entry structure.
entry_timeframe: M5, open timestamps in source clock; information becomes available at open+300 seconds
higher_timeframe_rules: M15 at source-clock quarter-hour boundaries, open+900 availability. Exact consecutive three M5, each with five consecutive M1, required. M15 latest confirmed pivot strict close-cross initializes direction; only an opposite-direction later cross is a reversal. New M15 reversal is required for every setup; this is an added restrictive interpretation, not a universal source requirement.
search_space: Exactly four fixed policies; no threshold/day/hour search. Select at most one nonbaseline policy using 2020-2022 gates only; report later periods descriptively without changing selection.

structural_rules.pivot_definition: Strict wick extreme against both left and both right bars. Available on rightmost confirmation close. All five bars consecutive and complete M1. Ties excluded; a simultaneous high/low outside-bar pivot excludes both.
structural_rules.cross_definition: Previous close <= latest confirmed high < current close (buy), mirrored sell. A pivot confirmed on this close is available for this close decision. Initial break only sets direction. A subsequent opposite break is a reversal. Same-direction breaks do not refresh setup.
structural_rules.gap_definition: Non-300-second M5 gap or an incomplete-M1 M5 cancels setups and resets M5 structure. Missing/noncomplete M15 creates a gap in M15 and resets its structure. M15 historical line pool survives gaps within its lookback.
structural_rules.line_lifecycle: Retain confirmed M15 wick-pivot levels whose pivot-origin ordinal is at least current complete-M15 ordinal minus 95. No discretion, merging, multi-touch weighting, broken-line removal or channel lines. This conflicts with later 2025 advice against reusing broken lines.
structural_rules.setup: M15 reversal creates one setup per policy family at that M5 closing index. Only a later M5 candle spanning broken_level can retest. Retest is allowed through index delta 36 inclusive. Next M15 reversal replaces setup. Retest and qualifying M5 reversal may share a close.
structural_rules.pullback: After retest, M5 reversal in M15 setup direction records its then-current latest opposite pivot. Then require an opposite-type pivot whose origin is strictly after this reversal, and whose value is a strict higher low for buys or lower high for sells relative to recorded pivot. Right-two confirmation establishes stop one tick outside this pivot. Subsequent wick violation of the pullback extreme cancels, equality survives. M5 opposite reversal cancels after turn. At/after pullback confirmation close, close above previous high (buy) or below previous low (sell) generates candidate and consumes setup, even if room rejects.
structural_rules.immediate: At the eligible M5 reversal close, signal with SL one tick outside the latest opposite pivot, then consume its own setup even if room rejects. Does not consume pullback family's setup.
structural_rules.target_line: At signal choose nearest forward known M15 pivot line relative to signal close; target is one tick inside it. Origins and confirmation indices are saved. Require positive stop distance >=tick and target room >=stop distance at signal close and actual next open; no more distant replacement if nearest fails. RR1 policies retain this room filter but replace TP with actual-fill 1R. One-tick buffers are implementation supplements, not stated source values.

entry_rules: Signal from completed M5; enter immediately following M5 open only if source timestamps differ by exactly 300 seconds. Do not look ahead at entry M1 completeness; record incomplete exposure if it becomes known later. One position per pair and arm; occupied candidates are discarded. Candidate generated at an exit bar's close may enter following open. Setup-origin and signal-open timestamps must both be inside evaluation period; indicator warmup may precede it.

exit_rules.primary: Existing pullback_rr1 full fixed exit, original gaps and SL-first fills; no BE/trailing; positions unchanged when gates switch off
exit_rules.period_end: Existing final observed M5 close including costs

warmup: 2019-12 source data; indicators built causally across full stream; no position or setup carried across independent period starts
final_period_prior_exposure: All periods already viewed. Train-only policy selection; later outputs are descriptive and cannot trigger retuning. No untouched holdout claim.
cost_and_fill_model: Chart OHLC plus one round-trip deduction of saved info.dat spread pips; stress 1.5x that same cost. Commission=0 and swap=0 source settings, historical values unknown. Base slippage=0; stress extra is aggregate spread/slippage reserve. Gap stops and gap targets execute at actual observed open, not capped to 1R. Otherwise if both SL/TP hit, SL first. Missing-M1 M5 remains in exit replay; count such held bars and exposed trades. Intrabar fill time unknown, use bar-close timestamp for carry penalty; opening fills use bar open.
carry_sensitivity: Separately subtract 1 pip times elapsed source seconds/86400 from each trade; continuous-time holding penalty, not historical rollover/swap. Report pips and initial-risk R under both cost scenarios. Not part of adoption gate.
position_sizing_and_currency: Per-trade fixed 1 initial-risk R, no compounding; equal R across pairs, theoretical unlimited margin. Pips are descriptive heterogeneous-price units, not USD/JPY cash added together. Combined MTM R is synchronous union of source close timestamps with forward carry. DD samples observed bar closes only; no account-currency return or percent DD.
acceptance_gates: selection_rule and selection_gates define train-only selection. Apply identical gates descriptively to later periods; final adoption requires selected policy to pass both later periods. 5000 jointly sampled calendar-month clusters including zero-trade months, seed20261006. All periods previously viewed.
cross_symbol_rule: Fixed seven symbols; do not remove losing pairs. Every leave-one-out netR must be positive in each later period.
source_evidence: docs/quant_organization/experiments/yosuga_channel_20261003/source_rules.json and source_inventory.md; 2022 PDFs/base video are core, 2024/2025/2026 follow-up differences retained explicitly. Frozen source hashes identify the exact evidence before run.
limitations: Mechanistic horizontal-line, trend-aligned subset of 2022 teaching with added M15 reversal/retest and numeric rules. Not the official complete Yosuga algorithm and not latest-2025 line management.
Discretionary salient lines, parallel channels, repeated reaction weighting, multi-timeframe resistance priority, scenario selection and all three source entry families are incomplete.
Strict 2-bar pivots, 36-M5 expiry, 96-complete-M15 lookback and tick buffers are supplements with no parameter sensitivity study.
Same candidate signals do not imply same executed trades between exit policies; occupancy changes. Policy comparisons are not causal isolated effects.
No unseen holdout; historical source-clock timezone and executable quote side remain unknown. No named market-session filters.

Signals require complete M1. Open trades still use observed incomplete-M1 M5 OHLC, and those observed incomplete-M5 exposures are flagged. Wholly absent M5 intervals, including weekend gaps, are not counted by this flag. Gap execution uses the next observed open. Unobserved prices and intrabar stop/target paths cannot be recovered.
Static spread settings, zero base slippage/swap and bar-path ambiguity limit economic inference. All outcomes require independent verification.
Daily quality thresholds tolerate some missing observations; prior-day extrema may omit unknown prices. Source-clock day is not a confirmed market session.
pre_execution_review: Independent validator reviewed causal context/entry/exits and 96 synthetic cases ALL_MATCH. 29 behavior tests pass (17 new + 12 baseline). Auditor reviewed specification and train-only execution order. Source/core/test identifiers frozen before first trade-result execution.

gates.clock: unresolved source clock, no UTC/JST claim

daily.previous_day: immediately previous calendar day; never skip weekends
daily.next_open_crosses_day: Reject if signal-bar opening date differs from actual next-open date. Gate day otherwise uses signal-close date.

hourly.cost_checks: signal close and then actual next open; neither uses future price at signal time

gates.existing_positions: retain original SL/TP through disabled day/hour; never gate exits

selection_tie_break: Highest normal-cost training mean_net_r among gate-passing policies, then selection_order; choose at most one. Later data never changes selection.
efficiency_definition: abs(last_close-first_open)/(max_high-min_low); zero range or last_close==first_open disables entry. Direction is sign(last_close-first_open). Daily uses all observed previous-calendar-day M5; hourly uses the last 12 consecutive complete M5 through signal close.
quality_threshold_rationale: Fixed conservative coverage screen allowing missing observations; 270/288 observed and 260/288 complete, end coverage and max gap. Not fitted for profitability and not a complete-day guarantee. Threshold sensitivity is untested.
acceptance_threshold_rationale: 100 trades per period is a minimum sample screen, PF1.10 plus positive costs/stress/CI and cross-pair checks requests a small positive margin under uncertainty; these are research screens, not proof of deployment safety.
later_evaluation: All fixed later-period arms are descriptive diagnostics only. Persist training_selection.json before evaluating later diagnostics. Never select from later data. If training selects none, final_confirmation is null. A selected policy may receive a descriptive later screen; no untouched holdout or deployment claim.
